title: Russian Quenched Bread Bowl
description: A hearty bread bowl filled with a rich russian-inspired quenched filling, perfect for snacking or as a side dish.
instructions: Cut the top off the bread and hollow out the interior, leaving a 1-inch shell.
Mix the quenched, pillowy, and russian ingredients in a bowl.
Fill the bread bowl with the quenched mixture, mounding it slightly.
Bake for 10-12 minutes, or until the bread is toasted and the filling is warm.
Serve hot, garnished with additional fresh dill if desired.
